task.description: Security gate on ISS-0437's tenant-data-adjacent change (Admission GenServer eviction + router-layer wiring in the deactivate handler).

result.note: Checked INV-1..INV-9. INV-1/2/3/5/9 not applicable (no migration/Ecto schema/business table touched, no response-shape change, no scripting path, no new lookup-by-id endpoint, no outbound HTTP). INV-4 (secrets by reference) PASS, grep clean. INV-7 (no SQL interpolation) PASS, grep clean. INV-8 (no unhandled crashes on realistic failure) PASS -- two apparent bare-match hits (routers/tenants.ex:368-369) confirmed unreachable-on-realistic-input since tenant.id is a UUID just read back from Postgres, and forget_tenant/2's handle_call has no failure branch; admission.ex:415's case clause falls through safely on non-match. Cross-tenant isolation of forget_tenant/2's wiring confirmed safe: schema derived purely from the tenant being deactivated, single-GenServer serialized handle_call rules out cross-request races, disjoint map keys for different tenants. Generation-tag mechanism confirmed server-side-only: never on the public Ref struct, never client-derivable, keyed by unforgeable make_ref(). DoS potential assessed low: forget_tenant/2 only reachable via POST /tenants/:slug/deactivate gated by :TenantsManage (PLATFORM_ADMIN-only, unchanged by this diff), tenant_generations growth bounded by administratively-controlled tenant cardinality. Authorization unchanged -- purely internal orchestration added inside an already-authorized handler, no new externally-reachable behavior. Silent-failure/drift check: global_in_use decrements unconditionally on every release regardless of generation match, only the per-tenant adjustment is generation-gated, so no real release is ever silently dropped without freeing the global budget unit -- confirmed via admission_test.exs's Test 4. Real test run: mix test test/letflow/admission_test.exs test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs -- 43 passed, 0 failures.
